model: Trident Z5 RGB DDR5-8000 CL40 (2 x 24 GB)

leds.direction: Along the light bar at the top edge of the module, from the left end of the picture (DIMM key side not verified) to the right; the module is drawn lying down, in the case it stands upright.

connection.notes: RGB controller on the module, addressed over SMBus (address range 0x70-0x77).

sources.note: approx. 43 mm height incl. contacts, 8.4 mm thick, 133.3 mm long (Trident Z5 RGB, other speed grade)
retailer listing of the 2 x 24 GB 8000 kit

notes: Dimensions are those reported for the Trident Z5 RGB family (the 8000 kit uses the same heat spreader); G.Skill's own datasheet value was not found. 8 LEDs per module are measured on the owner's sticks. LED order along the bar and positions are approximate.
